title: The new menu
summary: The club has hired a nutritionist and the canteen has to do quinoa. The woman who runs it asks what you think of the quinoa. A season on, there's a shepherd's pie on Fridays again.

ends.title: Friday's pie
ends.text: You told the canteen the truth about the quinoa, and now there's shepherd's pie on Fridays.

ends.title: The quinoa
ends.text: You said the quinoa was lovely. It's on every day now.

beats.title: The quinoa

event.title: The quinoa
event.speaker: canteen
setup: There's a laminated menu on the canteen hatch from the new nutritionist. Quinoa, three ways. {canteen.name} is behind the hatch with a ladle, waiting for you to say something.

say: "Be honest with me. I've made it three ways. Which way is least bad?"

honest.text: She nods slowly and writes something on the back of an order pad. She doesn't say what.

nice.text: "Lovely," she says. She gives you double. Then triple.

gravy.text: She puts gravy on it. It's much better. The nutritionist sees and goes very quiet.

beats.hint: The canteen has a new menu

beats.title: Friday

event.title: Friday
event.speaker: canteen
setup: A season on. The laminated menu on the hatch has a new line at the bottom in her handwriting.
{if arc.path=='honest'}"FRIDAY: SHEPHERD'S PIE (OFF THE RECORD)." She winks at you.{/if}
{if arc.path=='nice'}"QUINOA: EVERY DAY (BY POPULAR DEMAND)." She points at you with the ladle.{/if}

outcomes.text: It's Friday and it's shepherd's pie. The nutritionist has some too and asks for the recipe.
There's no pie, only quinoa. She gives you triple.
She looks at you like you've let her down. You have the pie as well.
Quinoa, triple. Somebody behind you in the queue says "thanks for that".

beats.hint: A season on, the canteen menu
